summary: The source contract fixes the puzzle at 81 cells, so the empty-cell count E is bounded by 81 and puzzle difficulty cannot provide an honest unbounded runtime-scaling axis.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The board always has nine rows of nine cells and is guaranteed to have exactly one solution.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each recursive level assigns one of at most E empty cells and branches over at most nine candidate digits; masks and minimum-remaining-values selection prune this finite O(9^E) search without enlarging it.

Regression solves 324 near-complete boards covering every one-cell hole plus same-row, same-column, and same-box two-cell holes, then verifies every authored source, solved, sparse, and digit-remapped puzzle in both app-local and immutable native sources.
